summary: Kinsella is a Canberra (Barton) chartered accounting firm, formed in 1998, offering tax consulting, a Virtual CFO service and an Outsourced Finance Function covering payroll, BAS and monthly reporting. Alex Breen is a Partner and co-owner with CFO and in-house finance experience. The firm uses Xero and is advertising for a Senior Accountant/Supervisor who would support the Virtual CFO / Outsourced Finance team.

sources.title: Yawning on a Tuesday? It might be a sign you have burnout

claims.text: Kinsella Chartered Accountants is located at Level 2, 26 Brisbane Avenue, Barton ACT, in Canberra.
Alex Breen is a current Partner at Kinsella (since July 2019), based in Canberra.
claims.quote: Partner - Kinsella Chartered Accountants (Current) Jul 2019 - Present

claims.text: Alex describes extensive experience in tax advisory, outsourced CFO roles, in-house financial management and business advisory.
claims.quote: extensive experience in tax advisory, outsourced CFO roles, in-house financial management and business advisory

claims.text: The AFR quoted Alex, a partner and co-owner, saying that waking at night worrying about clients made him realise there was too much going on.
claims.quote: it was the nightly waking at 2am or 3am worrying about clients that made him realise there was too much going on

claims.text: Kinsella's Outsourced Finance Function includes payroll, BAS, monthly reporting and management reporting normally handled by an internal finance team.
claims.quote: This includes the preparation of payroll, Business Activity Statements, Monthly Reporting and Management reporting

claims.text: Kinsella offers a Virtual CFO service and can work with a client's internal finance team or build a full outsourced finance solution.
claims.quote: We can work with your internal finance team or develop a complete outsourced finance solution

claims.text: Kinsella partners with Xero and its job ad says it uses cloud-based accounting systems including Xero.
claims.quote: We leverage the latest cloud-based accounting systems, including Xero, to streamline processes and enhance efficiency.

claims.text: Kinsella is advertising a Senior Accountant/Supervisor role that involves BAS, financial statements and the Virtual CFO / Outsourced Finance function team.
claims.quote: with involvement in our Virtual CFO/Outsourced Finance function team

claims.text: In October 2026 Kinsella advertised a Senior Administrator role referencing practice software FYI and XPM, with ATO lodgement management.
claims.quote: willingness to learn firm-specific software, including FYI, XPM

claims.text: Kinsella was formed in 1998 and describes itself as a full-service firm.
claims.quote: Formed in 1998, Kinsella has grown into a full service that provides tailored solutions to suit your needs.

hooks.text: Outsourced Finance Function closes clients' months in-house (payroll, BAS, monthly reporting); his own background includes outsourced CFO and in-house finance roles.
Live Senior Accountant/Supervisor ad that supports the Virtual CFO/Outsourced Finance team signals capacity pressure on that work.
Alex's AFR comment about worry-driven overload; use sparingly and humanely.

risks.text: No evidence of an existing AI reconciliation tool, but the firm is Xero-based with FYI/XPM practice software; unknown whether Dext/A2X-style automation is in place.
The AFR burnout reference is personal; keep it light.

gaps: No Alex Breen LinkedIn posts or podcast appearances found beyond a 2019 partner announcement.
No Kinsella blog or newsletter found.
Mid-size staffing (about 16 per input) not confirmed on a public page.
